Wait, `c3nc(-c4ccccc4)nn3` is a 1,2,3-triazole or pyrazole? `n-n-c-n` pattern suggests a triazole. Actually, `c3nc(-c4ccccc4)nn3` is a 1,2,3-triazole ring attached via C3 to the ethyl chain.
